About Roomwise

Better rooms.
Real-life budgets.

Roomwise helps you make more of the space you already call home.

We start with existing furniture, clutter, layout, and personal preferences. Our focus is practical improvements: better circulation, useful storage, and comfortable spaces within a realistic budget.

See your room from above, try a new arrangement, and compare the possibilities before moving a single piece of furniture.

Our vision is to use computer vision to turn room photos into floor plans and machine learning to suggest arrangements around your priorities.

Open the room planner

Use what you already have

Rearranging a sofa or clearing a corner should come before buying a whole new room.

A plan that fits your life

A shared apartment, a tight budget, or a work-from-home corner each needs a different plan. Build an arrangement around what matters to you.
